title: Map tools and orders
kicker: World and empire · beyond march and claim
hook: **WIP:** tools and orders beyond basic march and claim — wardens, cede, dowse, lenses, outliner. Not finished / not fully playable yet.

blindSpots.meaning: Not finished. Basic march and claim ship; this richer toolkit is still hardening.
A demon bound to hold ground on the map — not a lawn-only role.
Give up a sector on purpose — a deliberate retreat, not only a Fracture loss.
A way to recolour how the map reads (supply, fog, and more) — not a combat element.

alsoTrue: Dowse is a stance for reading the ground. Outliner lists legions and held sectors without hunting the canvas.
March, claim, End Turn, fog, and Zomboss already ship without this full toolkit.

sections.title: What you do today
paras: Use march, claim, and End Turn on the shipped map.
Treat missing warden or cede controls as unfinished work.

groups.title: On the World map
groups.intro: When tools ship, they hang on the same adventure surface.
steps: Open World as you do now.
Look for order / tool controls beyond move and claim.
Until they appear, do not invent hotkeys — play the shipped verbs.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Practice march, claim, and End Turn — those are live.
When warden or cede appears, follow on-screen prompts.
Do not assume every fog or supply colouring tool exists yet.
doNote: Stop when toolkit ≠ required for basic adventure. Related: [world map](world-map), [farm / hunt / defend](farm-hunt-defend).

mixUps.q: Why can’t I cede a sector?
mixUps.a: Cede is WIP. You can still lose ground to neglect / Fracture.

mixUps.q: Are wardens the same as commanders?
mixUps.a: No. Wardens bind demons to hold ground; commanders lead runs or legions.

mixUps.q: Is the outliner required to play?
mixUps.a: No. It is a WIP convenience over the canvas.
No. They change how the map reads.
